gaps: The candidates' original prediction-time snapshots and document manifests are not staged; changes in extraction coverage must be assessed from their logs and prose.
Unobserved candidate tool results limit independent verification of retrieved background facts; the result-capture markers make that limit explicit.
helpful: Blinded candidate artifacts preserve probability, frozen context, rationale, and retrieval evidence without exposing predictor identities.
The decided snapshot and OCR-derived application support an independent read of the disposition and case stakes.
The committed interim statpack separates the relevant substantive population from cert bands and extension requests.
notes: No live corpus, CourtListener, or web retrieval was needed. The committed statpack was consulted to assess baseline use, not to write a replacement for the harness-stamped interim rate. No blocker or observed outcome leakage required a flags file.
tools_used: shell reads of provisioned inputs and schemas
